From: Marta Ruiz <marta@acmehealth.com>
To: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 18 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Migration deep-dive / architect handoff

Hi Marcus,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. We need to set up a technical deep-dive to coordinate the migration from our current self-hosted inference stack to Redwood for the planned PoC. Primary goals:
- Confirm network/topology constraints for live traffic cutover
- Review model artifacts (quantized weights, KV cache patterns) and cold-start behavior
- Walk through rollback/fallback plans and monitoring expectations

Our engineering team is available next week, preferably in the morning PST. Proposed windows:
- Tue Jul 20, 09:00–10:30 PT
- Wed Jul 21, 10:00–11:30 PT
- Thu Jul 22, 08:30–10:00 PT

I've attached our internal security questionnaire and a short note on regulatory constraints. Please cc anyone from your side who should join (ops + platform).

Thanks,
Marta Ruiz
Head of Platform Engineering — ACME Health

Appreciate the context. Lauren (solutions) and Monica (eng lead for migrations) will join. We can do Tue Jul 20 09:00 PT; that slot works for our infra engineers and gives us time to prepare a short runbook. Agenda proposal (30/60 split):

- 09:00–09:30: High-level topology + constraints (network, VPC peering, egress)
- 09:30–10:00: Model serving details (quantization, KV cache migration, cold-start mitigation)
- 10:00–10:20: Rollout plan & canary strategy
- 10:20–10:30: Action items & next steps

I'll attach our PoC runbook and initial architecture sketch. Can you confirm if the session should include procurement or legal for the contracting bits? If so, we can leave a 15-min buffer at the end for commercial follow-up.

Regards,

Thanks — Tue 09:00 PT is good for us if you can keep to the agenda. A couple of clarifications we want covered:
- KV cache warmup: our current inference infra relies heavily on prepopulated KV caches per model shard — we'll need migration strategies for cache warming and traffic shaping
- Quantized model parity: we will bring up both float16 and int8 variants and want to understand Redwood's quantized inference accuracy tradeoffs

Samir (copied) is our external systems integrator and will join the call to clarify network and deployment automation. For contracting: procurement will not join the technical call but will want the agenda and runbook afterwards.

Marta
